g.text: Thursday 30 July, 10:20. Before anything in LANTERN's memory is trusted with the trail of case file 02,
Varma wants it traced again from the statements and nothing else: every hop from Corvane. The nine
statements run to forty-two pages as the banks printed them.
Reading forty-two pages in the main context would leave room for little else.
"Send someone to read them," Varma says, "and have them report."
That is what a sub-agent is. It reads in a window of its own and hands back five lines. Case file 02
chapter 18 measured what teams of agents cost. This is a smaller question.
Okafor asks it. "What was on the pages it decided I did not need?"
Page 8 of 24: Arden Logistics Ltd, account KB-117-60218, Kestrel Bay Commercial Bank.

. The questions the reports did not cover
Follow-up questions, asked in each main context as the trace left it
The trail's seven hops are on 13 of 42 pages, 8,784 tokens. Read in one context, the trace stopped (over
budget before turn 10) after 9 requests with 1 of 7 hops and 0 totals right; its largest request was
7,526 tokens. With readers, the main context's largest request was 5,116 tokens and it found 6 of 7
hops, 0 totals right, while 8 readers processed 16,747 tokens it never saw. Checked in code, the
accepted reports carried 9 wrong totals and 6 wrong counts and left out 5 payees, none of which the main
context could see. Asked three follow-up questions, the one context answered 1 and the main context with
